storyCards.headline: Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Elton John's "Lucy In The Sky With Diamonds" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.
